sources.entry: Kiwi IRC - Responsive web IRC client with theming support. (Demo, Source Code) Apache-2.0 Nodejs

summary.one_liner: Kiwi IRC is a web-based IRC client that runs as static files in the browser, built with Vue.js.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Kiwi IRC as a web messenger for IRC that is delivered as 100% static files, hostable on any web server or CDN. It can connect directly to a websocket IRC server, go through the webircgateway websocket proxy for regular IRC servers, or stay connected via KiwiBNC. It offers single or multiple network connections, several layouts, light and dark modes, desktop notifications, and a team mode. Runtime behavior is controlled by a single JSON config file (static/config.json), and theming and plugins (such as file uploading and video calling) are supported. Pre-built installers are offered on a downloads page, and the source is built with Yarn, webpack and Babel.
use_cases: Host a web-based IRC chat client on my own site
Embed an IRC chat widget on a website
Front-end for a bouncer or IRC network I connect to
Team chat using IRC in a workplace
Customize IRC client theme and layout
how_to_run: Copy the dist/ folder to your web server
yarn run dev (development server, not for production)
notable: Ships as 100% static files with no server-side component required
Single runtime JSON config file controls behavior
Connects via direct websocket, webircgateway proxy, or KiwiBNC
Supports light and dark modes, multiple layouts and plugins
Hosted custom client builder available at kiwiirc.com
caveats: Development server is slow, large and insecure, so it must not be used on live sites
Other browsers beyond the listed ones are not actively tested; IE11 is listed as supported
Pre-built installers are referenced via the downloads page rather than included in the README
